entries.title: The Vision of Aridæus (Echoes from the Gnosis, Vol. III)
entries.author: G. R. S. Mead
entries.notes: Echoes from the Gnosis vol. III — Mead's rendering of the myth of Aridaeus/Thespesius from Plutarch's De sera numinis vindicta, with commentary. London, Theosophical Publishing Society, 1907. On archive.org only as a sub-file of an 'Echoes I–XI' user bundle (2026-09-20); 86 leaves per its scandata.
